ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rhombus ABCD, the diagonals AC and BD intersect at point O, DE $\perp$ AB at point E, and OE is connected. If DE $= \sqrt{3}$, and BE $= 1$, what is the degree measure of $\angle ABD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus, \\
$\therefore$ AC $\perp$ BD, DO=BO, \\
Since DE $\perp$ AB, DE=$\sqrt{3}$, BE=1, \\
$\therefore$ BD=$\sqrt{DE^2+BE^2}=2$, \\
$\therefore$ DO=BO=1, \\
Because DE $\perp$ BA, DO=BO, \\
$\therefore$ EO=DO=BO=1, \\
$\therefore$ BE=BO=EO=1, \\
$\therefore$ $\triangle$BEO is an equilateral triangle, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle$ABD=$\boxed{60^\circ}$,

Thus BE = BO = EO = 1, so triangle BEO is equilateral. Therefore, \angle ABD = 60^\circ.
